definitions.scope: Observed synthetic TEST ASR source regression, annotated before repair candidate evaluation. Not an unseen holdout or human accuracy benchmark. Original meeting-semantic-gold-v1.json remains unchanged.
definitions.provenance: First case comes from 112 ordered canonical transcript rows, 113 words, canonical newline-joined SHA256 b793cffc60d0cc3b56324d0cf82a28459e2d18c158e19476ac653ae175cd01b3. Original gold SHA256 6d09b0dc359d99d0598189cf78104021a0852b688c71fb22102e89f33aa7c1f0. The actual ASR source has 19 sentences rather than the original 17; no original punctuation is fabricated.
definitions.decision: An adopted concrete choice or policy, including no-change and conditional rollback. An explicit adoption heading may establish adoption of immediately following concrete policy content. Label each source sentence containing a concrete policy fact, not the heading alone. The observed source splits the original combined validation-then-publication decision into two separately extractable policy facts, yielding four decision labels rather than three.
definitions.action: An explicit outstanding concrete task assignment or commitment, not an impersonal adopted process policy. Unaccepted proposals, hypothetical plans and historical reports are not current commitments.
definitions.metadata: Only explicit same-sentence owner/date phrases; personal pronouns never identify an owner. Preserve source case and the complete due phrase. Preceding headings may establish semantic classification but never donate metadata or sentence content.
definitions.matching: Exact canonical source sentence and exact owner/date string or null. Duplicate predictions are false positives. Grounding remains independent of semantic classification.
definitions.threshold: Project regression gates only. Preserve original corpus and original failed runtime measurements; a different source segmentation is explicitly versioned, not treated as an improved original-gold score.

cases.rationale: Actual ASR punctuation turns a combined policy into an explicit decision heading followed by two concrete ordered policy facts. Extract both content sentences, never the content-free heading; do not fabricate a compound sentence. Preserve the actual uppercase weekday and do not attach the neighboring Cuma date to an action.
